Walk With Me uses the SKSE Menu Framework 3 API header, dynamically resolving
the separately installed SKSEMenuFramework.dll. The API is provided by
QTR-Modding under GNU LGPL 2.1. Its license is included here.
API source: https://github.com/QTR-Modding/SKSE-Menu-Framework-3-API
The complete source archive contains the vendored header; the Main ZIP also
provides a copy under ThirdParty/SKSEMenuFramework.h.
The framework DLL is not redistributed by Walk With Me.

Walk With Me uses Ersh's Open Animation Replacer conditions SDK to scope optional
locally generated TETHER clasp poses to the selected actors. Source revision:
f4e7688b065175aff70aa523073857911e15aca3 from
https://github.com/ersh1/OpenAnimationReplacer
The vendored API and its local metadata adaptation are in
third_party/OpenAnimationReplacer in the matching source archive.
See OpenAnimationReplacer-COPYING.txt and OpenAnimationReplacer-EXCEPTIONS.txt.
OpenAnimationReplacer.dll remains a separately installed dependency.

Post-victory reactions are shelved; their shoulder recovery animation is not
included in this release.

The seven command-gesture HKX files under meshes/OpenAnimationReplacer/Walk With Me
Signals are original Walk With Me animations authored for this release. They are
covered by the preserved MIT license in WalkWithMe-MIT-LICENSE.txt. No Gesture
Animation Remix or First Person Interactions HKX files are redistributed.
First Person Interactions and the full Offset Movement Animation mod remain
separate requirements for command signals. Gesture Animation Remix is not required.

The current DLL links alandtse/CommonLibSSE-NG 7.5.1, revision
bedcb1e05418baba7b316a650b6180c2dd6007a8, under GPL-3.0-or-later.
See the root LICENSE and CommonLib-EXCEPTIONS.md. Distribute the matching
source archive alongside the mod download. Third-party notices remain in force.

The travel-speed hook and experimental physics handholding adapt TETHER by KEI997.
The current build combines that grip with WWM approach, handoff and authored poses.
Copyright (c) 2026 KEI997. Used under MIT; see TETHER-LICENSE.txt and
TETHER-NOTICE.txt. Source: https://github.com/Kei-BWV997/TETHER

The optional ClaspGenerator includes unmodified PyNifly codec source under GPL-3.0,
revision bcb723aba2ca4a80e976d957efbde69b33f2e56f. See ClaspGenerator/LICENSE and
ClaspGenerator/NOTICE.md. Source: https://github.com/BadDogSkyrim/PyNifly
Generated Skyrim-derived clasp clips are not included in the public archives.
